remainingPlan.reason: All local source/package/install/native/normal-commit/graphify consumers are terminal; cloud CI and draft publication use retained artifact/remote source. The Dev checkout retains its own dependencies.
remainingPlan.negativePath: Refuse tracked outputs, alias/reparse/hardlinks, unexpected WORK entries or any active owned consumer.

releaseWorktree.method: Official attach existing Dev, then archive the no-longer-primary temporary release worktree; no manual worktree removal.

devCloseTransientCleanup.graphify: terminal, no topology changes; one compact log retained

retention.recordClose: The previously archived source checkout was restored only to correct publication records. Existing owned Dev dependencies are linked temporarily, with no install/copy; links are removed non-recursively and checkout retired after final hook/push.

limits: Windows x64 with the X4 9.00 reference corpus is the validated host.
Headless installed contracts are separate from actual installed-editor rendering, restart and client-adoption experience.
The #53 nested transaction cold-start game witness remains queued with Claude; no discovery-proof claim.
The #94 Windows uppercase-filename engine witness has language/platform limits; selected-language/fallback and case-sensitive platforms remain unproven.
#93 and broader Dev/backlog work are excluded.
No live installation, game input, save or configuration changes.

The existing generic VSIX platform metadata does not restrict installation by OS/CPU. Bundled native dependencies are Windows x64; compatible guarded operations on other platforms are not claimed or tested, and bootstrap has no automatic native rebuild/download.

A Git-checkout frontend rebuild exposed Git-derived build-label differences; reproducing the original Git-free archive context restored exact runtime parity.
Commit wrapper omitted the qualified explicit E2E Node path; the unchanged hook refused and required the original sealed runtime override.

Cleanup preflight correctly stopped before mutation when my mirror check assumed QA-only installed-byte reports also existed in the raw native run. The owning collector mirrors 12 raw outputs; all 12 match, with independent review.

Announcement verification initially assumed message IDs appeared in the first 300 logged response bytes. Actual successful type-0 message responses were retained; no publication or announcement was retried.
sustain: Exact source/VSIX/native receipt chain and strict fail-closed ownership
Compact failure evidence and same-path retries instead of installation backups

aar.remainingRisk: No remaining public-delivery blocker. Editor/game experience and broader programme issues remain open with their own acceptance.
